task: Owner request (2026-11-01/02): move the local Vagrant cluster to the latest kube-ready-box OS (then 0.3.1) and test the existing implementation on it. Pin dasomel/ubuntu-26.04-xfs 0.3.1 from the kube-ready-box GitHub Pages catalog, raise worker vCPU after a full build ran out of CPU requests, and document the arm64 vmware_desktop-only constraint.

events.summary: Change Vagrantfile (box 0.1.0 -> 0.3.1 with box_url catalog; WORKER_CPUS default 4 with a validated NARWHAL_WORKER_CPUS override), VERSIONS.md and compatibility-matrix box rows, README/README-ko requirements (arm64 vmware_desktop only, 40GB RAM, 18 vCPU) and one lessons-log row. Deliberately left alone: master sizing, memory, the VirtualBox provider block (kept for older boxes), the airgap bundle contents.

First full build on box 0.3.0 with 2-vCPU workers (2026-11-02): up.sh exit 0 after Phase 2 attempt 2, but worker CPU requests were 97-99% (about 15% actual), keycloak-0 (600m) stayed Pending with 'Insufficient cpu', and the Falco DaemonSet was Pending on two workers. Giving Falco system-node-critical made it preempt keycloak-0 (event Preempted) and SSO went down; reverted in Gitea.

events.summary: 0.3.1 (2026-11-01T17:45Z): Ubuntu-only rebuild of the arm64 vmware_desktop boxes; installer GRUB args removed, leftover installer kernels purged; ubuntu-26.04-xfs kernel 7.0.0-42-generic. The catalog lists 0.3.1 and 0.3.0 vmware_desktop/arm64 with sha256 checksums and GitHub release URLs; Vagrant Cloud stopped accepting versions on 2026-10-01.

Vagrantfile pins box_version 0.3.1 and box_url to the catalog (D-BOX-CATALOG); WORKER_CPUS = Integer(ENV.fetch('NARWHAL_WORKER_CPUS','4'), exception: false) with an abort for non-positive or non-integer input (D-WORKER-CPUS).

VERSIONS.md / compatibility-matrix box rows -> v0.3.1; README/README-ko requirements say arm64 vmware_desktop only, 40GB+ RAM, 18 vCPU and the override; lessons-log row with the discriminator that priority only moves the victim on a requests-full cluster.

Independent review (native Sonnet code-reviewer) returned FAIL on 785daccc: behavior-contract required an operational trace (VERSIONS.md is high-risk), README still advertised VirtualBox and had no host CPU/RAM requirement, and NARWHAL_WORKER_CPUS was unvalidated. Added this trace, the README requirements and the input validation.
